items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And the band was Tom Brown, who, he's in the Orleans Clanniers... I get a job to go with the group in South Bend, A Downer.

ctx.x: I mean, it stayed with me because that was really a major disappointment in my life by not getting in that band. So I thought about what he had said. And shortly afterwards, I get a job to go with the group in South Bend, A Downer. So I had definitely made up my mind, I say. Because these fellas that I was going to work with, I mean, they were all new to me. I didn't know anything about them because it was different category of musicians and different fellas that I didn't know at that time. So I say, well, I'm…
Oh, I didn't know. Yeah, he's on some of those records with me.
